verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a local CLI installer and leaderboard that writes skill files to project or user directories on the user's own machine (./<agent>/skills/ or ~/<agent>/skills/). It is not a hosted service that stores user data in cloud regions, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this product type. The project/global install-path choice is about filesystem location, not data residency, so it is not credited here.
